name: pixel-companion
description: A free, local-only pixel-art desktop companion for emotional support and gentle accountability.
author: Pixel Companion contributors

scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:main && wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron .

scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
